citations.title: Imperial Brands CEO departure spooks market, CFO to take reins

sentences.text: Lukas Paravicini, CFO since May 2021, became chief executive on 1 October 2025, succeeding Stefan Bomhard, who remained on the board until 31 December 2025 and available until May 2026 to support the transition; Murray McGowan, previously chief strategy and development officer, became CFO and a board member on the same date.

In January 2026 the company named John Rishton as non-executive director and chair designate, joining the board on 13 July 2026, succeeding Therese Esperdy as chair on 1 December 2026, when she retires from the board.

sentences.quote: Paravicini told investors on an analysts' call he was committed to Imperial's five-year strategy set out in March and a capital allocation framework based around healthy returns for shareholders.
sentences.text: Paravicini told investors he was committed to the five-year strategy and a capital allocation framework based on healthy shareholder returns, with the group targeting up to 5% annual profit growth until 2030.
